verdict.rationale: Pipeline CRM documents its own bulk capabilities in two narrow areas: data enrichment can run on "hundreds at once", and sequenced campaigns can be sent to a filtered list. There is no evidence of general bulk edit, update, delete, reassign or stage-move across many records, either in the UI, via Copilot or through a bulk API endpoint. Missing for 10: general-purpose bulk edit/update/delete of records, bulk actions driven by Copilot or the API, documented limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Enrich single records or hundreds at once, whenever you choose
Send sequenced campaigns to a filtered list from inside the CRM
